about_the_game:
Step deeper into the mystery with the new DLC for Secrets of Salem: The Phantom Cab! Detective Victor Grayson’s pursuit of the phantom cab expands into four new locations, each filled with dangerous secrets and long-forgotten truths. Search for hidden objects, unlock fresh puzzles, and uncover personal stories that bring Salem’s haunting past into sharper focus. From cursed relics to magical records, every scene challenges your wits and brings you closer to unraveling the truth behind Victor’s missing brother.

Packed with hidden object challenges, unique mini-games, and fresh lore, this expansion delivers more ways to explore Salem’s chilling legends. Will you uncover the secrets waiting in the shadows, or become another name in the city’s long line of mysteries?

🔮 Elliot’s Secret Place

Explore the rooftop hideout where Elliot once lingered. Among dusty books and hidden mementos, you may stumble upon personal notes and rare evidence that reveal more about his connection to Salem’s darkest mysteries.

🔮 The Depot Manager’s Office

This forgotten office was sealed the moment the case was declared closed. Unlock safes, solve puzzles, and dig through old files to uncover documents and artifacts that could finally shed light on the truth.

🔮 The Old Church

A place radiating strange magical energy. Search hidden chambers, examine ancient records, and piece together clues about Salem’s witches — knowledge that may prove vital in facing Charles and his powers.

🔮 The Break Room

A cluttered, ordinary-looking space that hides extraordinary secrets. Rummage through suitcases, vending machines, and personal belongings to uncover the story of Charles’ past and gain the tools to complete the ritual.

Will you dare to investigate further and face the cab’s ghostly curse, or will Salem’s secrets consume you forever?
